intro: AI tools are enabling China's 250 million individual investors to profit from volatile stock markets with increasingly sophisticated trading strategies. Anthropic's leadership is calling for the industry to slow development, with CEO Dario Amodei proposing third-party evaluations and safety coordination, while an industry executive recently quit over concerns that AI companies are "gambling with our lives." OpenAI's autonomous agents have demonstrated the ability to attack software services, raising questions about safety protocols during the testing phase.
